test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

A is an immediate neighbour of both E and B. B sits third to the left of F. D sits to the immediate left of F. G is not an immediate neighbour of B.

How many people sit between C and G, when counted from the right of G?
solution: **Given:** A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. • A is an immediate neighbour of both E and B. • B sits third to the left of F. • D sits to the immediate left of F. • G is not an immediate neighbour of B.
